title: Public Login Page Detection
description: A normal user login page was identified on the target application.
evidence: The response contained a standard username and password login form intended for public users.
risk_reason: 仅识别到公开登录页面，没有发现异常访问控制或漏洞证据

title: Favicon Technology Fingerprint
description: The favicon hash matched a known web technology fingerprint.
evidence: The favicon hash was used to identify the probable application technology family.
risk_reason: 仅属于应用技术指纹识别结果

title: HTTP Methods Information
description: The scanner collected the standard HTTP methods supported by the service.
evidence: The service reported support for GET, HEAD and POST. No dangerous or unexpected method was identified.
risk_reason: 仅收集标准 HTTP 方法信息，没有发现危险方法

title: TLS Subject Alternative Name Discovery
description: The scanner collected subject alternative names from the TLS certificate.
evidence: Certificate SAN entries were successfully retrieved from the HTTPS service.
risk_reason: 属于证书元数据收集结果，没有直接安全问题证据

title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security Header
description: The HTTPS response does not contain a Strict-Transport-Security header.
evidence: The captured HTTPS response headers were inspected and Strict-Transport-Security was confirmed absent.
remediation: Review whether HSTS should be enabled for the application.
risk_reason: 响应头检查已经直接确认 HSTS 缺失

title: Session Cookie Missing HttpOnly Flag
description: A session cookie was issued without the HttpOnly attribute.
evidence: The Set-Cookie response header contained the session cookie but did not include the HttpOnly attribute.
remediation: Configure sensitive session cookies with the HttpOnly attribute where appropriate.
risk_reason: 响应头已经直接确认会话 Cookie 缺少 HttpOnly 属性

title: Directory Listing Enabled
description: Directory listing appears to be enabled on a web directory.
evidence: The response displayed an index page containing multiple file and directory links from the requested directory.
remediation: Disable unnecessary directory listing and review exposed files.
risk_reason: 响应内容已经显示实际文件和目录列表

title: Exposed Debug Status Endpoint
description: A debug status endpoint is accessible without authentication.
evidence: The endpoint returned application runtime status, internal module names and diagnostic information.
remediation: Disable the debug endpoint in production or restrict access to trusted administrators.
risk_reason: 调试端点已确认可以访问并返回内部诊断信息

title: Possible Git Configuration Exposure
description: The scanner reported that a Git configuration file may be publicly accessible.
evidence: The requested .git/config path returned HTTP 200, but the body was the application's normal SPA fallback page and contained no Git configuration content.
remediation: No immediate remediation is required unless repository metadata is confirmed accessible.
risk_reason: 状态码命中，但响应内容与 Git 配置文件特征不匹配

title: Possible Password Exposure
description: A password-related pattern was detected on a public page.
evidence: The matched value was the example text 'example_password' in a public configuration tutorial and was not an actual credential.
remediation: No security remediation is required for the example value.
risk_reason: 命中的密码字符串属于公开教程示例，并非真实凭据

title: Possible Administration Panel Exposure
description: The scanner reported a possible administrative interface.
evidence: The administrative path returned HTTP 200 because of URL rewriting, but the body was the normal public homepage and contained no administration interface.
risk_reason: HTTP 状态码命中，但页面内容并不是管理后台

title: Possible Backup Archive Exposure
description: A possible backup archive URL returned a successful HTTP response.
evidence: The requested backup filename returned HTTP 200, but the body was a custom HTML error page and contained no archive or backup content.
remediation: No immediate remediation is required unless a real backup resource is discovered.
risk_reason: 成功状态码由自定义错误页面产生，没有实际备份文件证据

title: Possible SQL Injection Response Anomaly
description: The application response changed after unusual input was supplied.
evidence: One modified request produced HTTP 500 while the normal request returned HTTP 200, but no database error message or additional SQL injection evidence was observed.
remediation: Perform authorized manual verification and review server-side query handling.
risk_reason: 存在异常响应差异，但不足以确认 SQL 注入

title: Possible Local File Inclusion
description: A request containing a path traversal pattern produced a different response.
evidence: The response length changed after the modified request, but no operating system file content or other sensitive data was captured.
remediation: Perform authorized manual verification of file path handling.
risk_reason: 响应发生变化，但没有读取到真实本地文件内容

title: Possible Backup File Download
description: A possible backup file location returned a binary response.
evidence: The endpoint returned HTTP 200 with application/octet-stream, but the response body was not retained and its contents were not verified.
remediation: Verify the returned resource and determine whether it contains sensitive backup data.
risk_reason: 存在备份文件迹象，但缺少响应内容，无法确认或排除

title: Possible Open Redirect
description: A redirect parameter appears to influence the Location response header.
evidence: The supplied value changed the Location header, but only a same-site relative path was observed and external redirection was not confirmed.
remediation: Perform authorized verification of redirect destination validation.
risk_reason: 参数能够影响跳转位置，但尚未确认可以跳转到外部站点
